name: Sylo
description: Sylo is a multi-function bot for Discord and Fluxer with a web dashboard. It runs on Discord, on Fluxer, or on both from one container (Fluxer support is experimental). It has a per-guild module system (35 modules) - moderation with warning thresholds and a numbered case log (/history, /case), server logging, tickets/modmail answered from the dashboard, reaction roles & autoroles, verification (Verify button or Cloudflare Turnstile captcha), welcome/leave messages, a Welcome Channel builder, birthday announcements, sticky messages, auto-moderation (invite/link/flood/mention/caps/word filters, optionally pushed to Discord's native AutoMod), a counting mini-game, action-based custom slash commands, an autoresponder, reminders (one-off or recurring channel posts), leveling (text + optional voice XP, per-role/channel multipliers, all-time/weekly/monthly public leaderboard), AFK, server statistics (live-count voice channels), server insights (activity charts - messages, joins/leaves and voice-channel usage over time), a free games notifier (Epic Games Store, plus more stores with an IsThereAnyDeal key), ban appeals (banned members get a DM'd link to an appeal form; staff accept/deny from the dashboard), MEE6-style temporary voice channels ("join to create" hubs plus /voice-* control commands), a starboard (re-posts messages that get enough of a reaction into a highlights channel), an invite tracker (credits who invited each member and ranks inviters), reaction polls (/poll with a timer or vote cap), prize giveaways (Enter button, auto-drawn winners), optional Battlefield-series and RuneScape (OSRS/RS3) player stats (/stats, gated by the Game stats module), Twitch / YouTube / Kick go-live & new-video alerts (with an optional "delete the message when the stream ends" mode), RSS/Atom feed alerts (plus Reddit / Mastodon / Bluesky handles), scheduled channel cleanup (auto-delete messages older than a threshold from a channel, on a weekly schedule you pick), and a message/embed creator - plus per-server command management, a Prometheus /metrics endpoint (a ready-made Grafana dashboard ships in the repo), and an editable Discord presence/activity. State is stored in a single SQLite file under /app/data and survives updates (Postgres is optional, see DATABASE_URL). The database is snapshotted automatically (before every schema migration and on a schedule) into /app/data/backups - optionally shipped off-site as well (WebDAV and/or a Discord webhook, optionally encrypted; see BACKUP_WEBDAV_URL / BACKUP_WEBHOOK_URL / BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY); from the dashboard's Health page you can also create, download, import and restore a snapshot (restore swaps the file and lets the container restart on the restored data). Setup (Discord): create a Discord application at https://discord.com/developers/applications, then set DISCORD_TOKEN (Bot tab) and DISCORD_CLIENT_ID (General Information). Invite the bot with the scopes "bot" and "applications.commands". Setup (Fluxer): create an application on your Fluxer instance and set FLUXER_TOKEN (bot token) and FLUXER_CLIENT_ID. For a self-hosted Fluxer instance also set FLUXER_WEB_URL. Fluxer has no slash commands yet, so commands run from chat with a prefix (!ping, set with COMMAND_PREFIX) and buttons are shown as reactions. Set only the platform(s) you use; at least one is required. See https://github.com/Ferdinand99/Sylo/blob/main/docs/fluxer.md Intents (Discord only; Fluxer has none): the member/message-driven modules (logging, welcome, reaction roles, verification, leveling, server statistics, invite tracker, auto-moderation, counting, autoresponder, starboard) need the "Server Members" and/or "Message Content" intents enabled on the Developer Portal Bot page. Leave INTENT_GUILD_MEMBERS / INTENT_MESSAGE_CONTENT at their defaults, or set one to false to boot without that intent (its modules stay unavailable). Dashboard: runs open by default (use only on a trusted LAN). To require a login for server admins, set DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET ("Log in with Discord") and/or FLUXER_CLIENT_SECRET ("Log in with Fluxer") and add http:// :[HOST-PORT]/auth/discord/callback and/or http:// :[HOST-PORT]/auth/fluxer/callback to the app's OAuth redirect URLs. One dashboard account can hold both logins. Put your own ids in OWNER_IDS (Discord) and FLUXER_OWNER_IDS (Fluxer), or nobody can open the Health page once login is on. Sylo app (iOS): the native app signs in to your instance with the same Discord/Fluxer login (needs DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET or FLUXER_CLIENT_SECRET and DASHBOARD_URL). Ticket notifications reach the phone through the hosted relay (PUSH_RELAY_URL); operators also get the Health page and dev-log notifications. See https://github.com/Ferdinand99/Sylo/blob/main/docs/mobile-app.md Community & support: https://discord.gg/GAzR9k5hhS

paths.name: Data Directory
paths.description: Where the SQLite database (sylo.db) is stored. Persists across updates/restarts.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the Sylo dashboard. Only change the host side; the container always listens on 3000.

variables.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
variables.description: Discord bot token (Developer Portal -> your app -> Bot -> Reset Token). Leave blank to run on Fluxer only.

variables.name: DISCORD_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Discord application (client) ID (Developer Portal -> your app -> General Information). Leave blank to run on Fluxer only.

variables.name: DISCORD_DEV_GUILD_IDS
variables.description: Optional. Set to a server ID (or several, comma-separated) to register slash commands to those guild(s) instantly (useful for testing). Leave blank to register globally (can take up to ~1 hour the first time).

variables.name: DISCORD_SHARD_COUNT
variables.description: Optional. Number of Discord gateway shards this one container runs. Leave blank (or 'auto') to follow Discord's recommendation - it stays at 1 until the bot is in ~2,500+ servers, so most instances never need this. Multi-process sharding is not supported.

variables.name: DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Optional. Set this (Developer Portal -> OAuth2 -> Client Secret) to require 'Log in with Discord' on the dashboard, restricted to server admins. Also add http:// :[HOST-PORT]/auth/discord/callback to the app's OAuth2 Redirects. Leave blank to run the dashboard open (trusted LAN only).

variables.name: FLUXER_TOKEN
variables.description: Fluxer bot token (your Fluxer application, bot page). Setting it runs Sylo on Fluxer too (experimental). Leave blank for Discord only.

variables.name: FLUXER_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Fluxer application id. Required when FLUXER_TOKEN is set.

variables.name: FLUXER_WEB_URL
variables.description: Self-hosted Fluxer only: the web app origin of your instance, e.g. https://chat.example.com. Leave blank for hosted Fluxer.

variables.name: FLUXER_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Optional: adds "Log in with Fluxer" to the dashboard (the Fluxer application client secret). Add http:// :[HOST-PORT]/auth/fluxer/callback to the application redirect URLs.

variables.name: OWNER_IDS
variables.description: Your Discord user id(s), comma-separated: the operators of this Sylo. With Discord login on, only these accounts can open the Health page (status, error log, database backup / restore), here and in the Sylo app, and get its dev-log notifications.

variables.name: FLUXER_OWNER_IDS
variables.description: Your Fluxer user id(s), comma-separated: the Fluxer counterpart of OWNER_IDS.

variables.name: DEV_LOG_CHANNEL_ID
variables.description: Optional. A Discord channel id where Sylo posts its own errors (a dev log, separate from any server's logging channel). Errors and warnings are also stored and shown on the Health page in the Sylo app, with or without this channel.

variables.name: COMMAND_PREFIX
variables.description: Chat prefix for commands on Fluxer, which has no slash commands yet (1-5 characters, no spaces). Members can also mention the bot instead.

variables.name: FLUXER_API_URL
variables.description: Optional, self-hosted Fluxer only: overrides the API origin of your instance. Rarely needed; leave blank to read it from FLUXER_WEB_URL.

variables.name: INTENT_GUILD_MEMBERS
variables.description: Whether to request the Server Members privileged intent (needed by logging, welcome, reaction roles/autoroles, verification, leveling, server statistics and the invite tracker). Must also be enabled on the Developer Portal Bot page. Set to false to boot without it - those modules then stay unavailable.

variables.name: INTENT_MESSAGE_CONTENT
variables.description: Whether to request the Message Content privileged intent (needed by logging, auto-moderation, the autoresponder, the counting game and the starboard). Must also be enabled on the Developer Portal Bot page. Set to false to boot without it - those modules then stay unavailable.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: Optional. Any long random string; signs the dashboard session cookie so logins survive a container restart. Auto-generated when blank.

variables.name: DASHBOARD_URL
variables.description: Optional. The public dashboard URL (e.g. https://sylo.example.com or http:// :[HOST-PORT]). Needed behind a reverse proxy for the OAuth2 redirect URI, for the Sylo app, and to build the links members open for verification-captcha and ban appeals. With it set, X-Forwarded-For is trusted from one proxy on a private address (see TRUST_PROXY). Leave blank for direct IP access without those features.

variables.name: TRUST_PROXY
variables.description: Optional. Which reverse proxies may tell Sylo the client's address (X-Forwarded-For). Blank: with DASHBOARD_URL set, one proxy on a loopback or private address (another container, your LAN). Set false, a hop count, or the proxy's addresses/subnets for other setups, e.g. a proxy on another server.

variables.name: ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS
variables.description: Optional. Set to true to let server admins use RSS feeds and welcome-card images on your own network (127.0.0.1, 192.168.x, 10.x ...). Off by default, because those URLs are fetched by the server.

variables.name: PUSH_RELAY_URL
variables.description: Where this instance sends Sylo app notifications (the hosted relay; it passes them to Apple and keeps no copy). Leave at https://app.sylobot.com; empty turns app notifications off.

variables.name: TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY
variables.description: Optional. Cloudflare Turnstile site key — enables the Verification module's captcha mode. Free at dash.cloudflare.com -> Turnstile. Needs both keys and DASHBOARD_URL set; otherwise captcha mode falls back to a plain Verify button.

variables.name: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Optional. Cloudflare Turnstile secret key — pairs with TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY for the Verification captcha.

variables.name: ITAD_API_KEY
variables.description: Optional. IsThereAnyDeal API key (free at isthereanydeal.com/apps) — broadens the Free games module beyond the Epic Games Store to Steam, GOG, Fanatical, Humble and more. Without it, Free games is Epic-only.

variables.name: TWITCH_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Optional. Twitch application client id for the Twitch alerts module ('go live' notifications). Free app at dev.twitch.tv/console. Needs TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET too; without both, the module's poll loop does nothing.

variables.name: TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Optional. Twitch application client secret, paired with TWITCH_CLIENT_ID for the Twitch alerts module.

variables.name: KICK_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Optional. Kick application client id for the Kick alerts module ('go live' notifications). Free app at kick.com/settings/developer. Needs KICK_CLIENT_SECRET too; without both, the module's poll loop does nothing.

variables.name: KICK_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Optional. Kick application client secret, paired with KICK_CLIENT_ID for the Kick alerts module.

variables.name: STATS_CACHE_TTL_MINUTES
variables.description: How long (minutes) to cache a stats lookup before hitting the API again.

variables.name: GAMETOOLS_API_BASE
variables.description: Base URL of the Battlefield stats API.

variables.name: DATABASE_PATH
variables.description: Path to the SQLite file inside the container. Must sit inside the Data Directory mount.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Optional. A postgres:// URL to use Postgres instead of the SQLite file (hosted-scale deployments). Leave blank for SQLite. See https://github.com/Ferdinand99/Sylo/blob/main/docs/postgres.md

variables.name: BACKUP_INTERVAL_HOURS
variables.description: How often (hours) to write an automatic compacted database snapshot into Data Directory/backups. A snapshot is also always taken just before a schema migration, and on demand from the Health page. Set to 0 to disable the scheduled backup.

variables.name: BACKUP_RETENTION
variables.description: How many database snapshots to keep in Data Directory/backups. Older ones are pruned automatically.

variables.name: BACKUP_DIR
variables.description: Optional. Directory (inside the container) for database snapshots. Leave blank to use Data Directory/backups; must sit inside the Data Directory mount if set.

variables.name: BACKUP_WEBDAV_URL
variables.description: Optional. Off-site backups: a WebDAV folder URL (e.g. a Nextcloud path like https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/me/sylo-backups). After every local snapshot a gzipped copy is PUT to url/name.db.gz. With a username it must be https (or a LAN / container address). Best-effort and logged; never blocks the local backup.

variables.name: BACKUP_WEBDAV_USER
variables.description: Optional. Username for BACKUP_WEBDAV_URL (HTTP basic auth). Use an app password, not your account password.

variables.name: BACKUP_WEBDAV_PASS
variables.description: Optional. Password / app password for BACKUP_WEBDAV_URL.

variables.name: BACKUP_WEBHOOK_URL
variables.description: Optional. Off-site backups: a Discord webhook URL. Each gzipped snapshot is uploaded as an attachment (skipped when it is over ~8 MiB — use WebDAV for a larger database).

variables.name: BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.description: Optional. A long passphrase: off-site copies (WebDAV / webhook) then leave encrypted (AES-256-GCM, name.db.gz.enc). Keep it somewhere else too; without it they cannot be read. Decrypt with: node scripts/decrypt-backup.js

variables.name: APPLE_KEY_ID
variables.description: Optional. App Store Connect API key id for the owner-only App Store Connect module (alerts about your own apps). Leave blank if you don't publish iOS/macOS apps.

variables.name: APPLE_ISSUER_ID
variables.description: Optional. Issuer id of a team App Store Connect API key (blank for an individual key).

variables.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY
variables.description: Optional. The App Store Connect key's .p8 file: PEM on one line with literal \n line breaks, or base64.

variables.name: APPLE_VENDOR_NUMBER
variables.description: Optional. Your App Store Connect vendor number (Sales and Trends), for the downloads digest.

variables.name: WEB_PORT
variables.description: Port the app listens on inside the container. Leave at 3000 unless you also change the container side of the WebUI Port mapping.

variables.name: NODE_ENV
variables.description: Node environment.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error. debug also emits one line per HTTP request.

variables.name: LOG_FORMAT
variables.description: Log line format: text or json (LOG_JSON=1 is shorthand for json).

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: IANA timezone name, used for timestamps in ticket transcripts and logs. Defaults to Europe/Oslo.
